48039: Consequently the actual quotient fibre is a one-dimensional complex module,
48040: the inverse-eta Hermitian pairing descends, and arbitrary covariant scalar
48041: lifts are equivalent to actual sections of the quotient projection.
48042: 
48043: No smooth vector-bundle structure is inserted as an assumption.  A final
48044: predicate at the end isolates only the atlas-level smoothness statement; the
48045: algebraic and topological trivializations themselves are constructed here.

48048: /-! ## 1. Exact specializations of the existing Mock2 quotient -/
48049: 
48050: /-- The upper half-plane used by the exact eta multiplier. -/
48051: abbrev H := Mock2.Definition15Geometry.H
48052: 
48053: /-- The actual principal congruence subgroup `Gamma(2)`. -/
48054: abbrev Gamma2 := Mock2.Definition15Geometry.Gamma2
48055: 
48056: /-- The literal orbit quotient `Gamma(2) \ H` from Mock2. -/
48057: abbrev InverseEtaBase := Mock2.Definition15Geometry.X
48058: 
48059: /-- The exact inverse-eta multiplier already constructed by Mock2. -/
48060: noncomputable abbrev inverseEtaMultiplier := QYM.FullCertification.Mock2EtaPeterssonCarrierExtension.etaMultiplier
48061: 
48062: /-- The actual orbit-quotient total space of the inverse-eta line. -/
48063: noncomputable abbrev InverseEtaTotal := QYM.FullCertification.Mock2EtaPeterssonCarrierExtension.EtaAutomorphicLineBundle.Total
48064: 
48065: /-- Re-expose the topology already carried by the concrete orbit quotient.
48066: This does not choose a new topology: it unfolds the stored bundle carrier to
48067: the exact `Quotient (lineOrbitRel inverseEtaMultiplier)` representation and
48068: uses Mathlib's existing quotient instance. -/

48263: noncomputable def inverseEtaTotalTrivialization :

48375: /-! ## 5. The actual quotient fibre as a one-dimensional complex module -/
48376: 
48377: /-- The invariant complex coordinate of a point in a fixed actual fibre. -/
48378: noncomputable def inverseEtaFibreCoordinate
48379:     {x : InverseEtaBase} (u : InverseEtaFibre x) : ℂ :=
48380:   etaTrivializedCoordinate u.1
48381: 
48382: /-- Build a point of the actual fibre from its unique complex coordinate. -/
48383: noncomputable def inverseEtaFibreOfCoordinate
48384:     (x : InverseEtaBase) (c : ℂ) : InverseEtaFibre x :=
48385:   ⟨totalOfBaseScalar x c,
48386:     inverseEtaProjection_totalOfBaseScalar x c⟩

48388: @[simp] theorem inverseEtaFibreCoordinate_ofCoordinate

48391:   etaTrivializedCoordinate_totalOfBaseScalar x c

48395:     inverseEtaFibreOfCoordinate x (inverseEtaFibreCoordinate u) = u := by
48396:   apply Subtype.ext

48399:   rw [← u.2]

48509: /-! ## 6. Descent of the exact inverse-eta Hermitian metric -/
48510: 
48511: /-- The descended Hermitian pairing on a fixed actual quotient fibre. -/
48512: noncomputable def inverseEtaFibreHermitian
48513:     {x : InverseEtaBase}
48514:     (u v : InverseEtaFibre x) : ℂ :=
48515:   ⟪inverseEtaFibreCoordinate u, inverseEtaFibreCoordinate v⟫_ℂ
48516: 
48517: /-- The descended pairing pulls back exactly to the base-dependent metric
48518: already constructed in P1. -/
48519: @[simp] theorem inverseEtaFibreHermitian_mk
48520:     (tau : H) (z w : ℂ) :
48521:     inverseEtaFibreHermitian
48522:         (inverseEtaFibreMk tau z) (inverseEtaFibreMk tau w) =
48523:       QYM.FullCertification.P1AdmissibleBackgroundExtension.inverseEtaHermitianMetricData.pairing tau z w := by
48524:   rw [inverseEtaFibreHermitian,
48525:     inverseEtaFibreCoordinate_mk, inverseEtaFibreCoordinate_mk,
48526:     QYM.FullCertification.P1AdmissibleBackgroundExtension.inverseEtaHermitianMetricData_pairing]
48527: 
48528: /-- Conjugate symmetry of the descended pairing. -/
48529: theorem inverseEtaFibreHermitian_conj_symm
48530:     {x : InverseEtaBase} (u v : InverseEtaFibre x) :
48531:     conj (inverseEtaFibreHermitian v u) =
48532:       inverseEtaFibreHermitian u v := by
48533:   exact inner_conj_symm _ _
48534: 
48535: /-- Additivity in the second argument. -/
48536: theorem inverseEtaFibreHermitian_add_right
48537:     {x : InverseEtaBase} (u v w : InverseEtaFibre x) :
48538:     inverseEtaFibreHermitian u (v + w) =
48539:       inverseEtaFibreHermitian u v +
48540:         inverseEtaFibreHermitian u w := by
48541:   simp only [inverseEtaFibreHermitian,
48542:     inverseEtaFibreCoordinate_add, inner_add_right]
48543: 
48544: /-- Complex linearity in the second argument. -/
48545: theorem inverseEtaFibreHermitian_smul_right
48546:     {x : InverseEtaBase} (c : ℂ) (u v : InverseEtaFibre x) :
48547:     inverseEtaFibreHermitian u (c • v) =
48548:       c * inverseEtaFibreHermitian u v := by
48549:   simp only [inverseEtaFibreHermitian,
48550:     inverseEtaFibreCoordinate_smul, inner_smul_right]
48551: 
48552: /-- The real part on the diagonal is the square of the descended norm. -/
48553: theorem inverseEtaFibreHermitian_self_re
48554:     {x : InverseEtaBase} (u : InverseEtaFibre x) :
48555:     (inverseEtaFibreHermitian u u).re =
48556:       ‖inverseEtaFibreCoordinate u‖ ^ 2 := by
48557:   unfold inverseEtaFibreHermitian
48558:   exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ)
48559:     (inverseEtaFibreCoordinate u)
48560: 
48561: /-- Positive definiteness on the actual quotient fibre. -/
48562: theorem inverseEtaFibreHermitian_self_pos
48563:     {x : InverseEtaBase} {u : InverseEtaFibre x} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
48564:     0 < (inverseEtaFibreHermitian u u).re := by
48565:   unfold inverseEtaFibreHermitian
48566:   rw [re_inner_self_pos (𝕜 := ℂ)]
48567:   intro hCoordinate
48568:   apply hu
48569:   apply (inverseEtaFibreCoordinateEquiv x).injective
48570:   simpa using hCoordinate
48571: 
48572: /-- The Hermitian norm on the actual quotient total space. -/
48573: noncomputable def inverseEtaTotalHermitianNorm
48574:     (u : InverseEtaTotal) : ℝ :=
48575:   ‖etaTrivializedCoordinate u‖
48576: 
48577: @[simp] theorem inverseEtaTotalHermitianNorm_mk
48578:     (tau : H) (z : ℂ) :
48579:     inverseEtaTotalHermitianNorm (inverseEtaTotalMk tau z) =
48580:       ‖Mock2.Definition15Geometry.EtaHalfWeight.etaValue tau * z‖ := by

48596: /-! ## 7. Covariant scalar lifts are exactly quotient sections -/
48597: 
48598: /-- All inverse-eta-covariant scalar lifts, with their actual pointwise
48599: complex-module structure. -/
48600: noncomputable def etaCovariantLiftModule : Submodule ℂ (H -> ℂ) where
48601:   carrier := QYM.FullCertification.Mock2EtaPeterssonCarrierExtension.EtaCovariant
48602:   zero_mem' := by
48603:     intro gamma tau
48604:     simp [QYM.FullCertification.Mock2EtaPeterssonCarrierExtension.etaAutomorphyFactor]
48605:   add_mem' := by
48606:     intro f g hf hg gamma tau
48607:     change
48608:       f (gamma • tau) + g (gamma • tau) =
48609:         QYM.FullCertification.Mock2EtaPeterssonCarrierExtension.etaAutomorphyFactor gamma tau * (f tau + g tau)
48610:     rw [hf gamma tau, hg gamma tau, mul_add]
48611:   smul_mem' := by
48612:     intro c f hf gamma tau
48613:     change
48614:       c * f (gamma • tau) =
48615:         QYM.FullCertification.Mock2EtaPeterssonCarrierExtension.etaAutomorphyFactor gamma tau * (c * f tau)
48616:     rw [hf gamma tau]
48617:     ring

48620: abbrev EtaCovariantLift := etaCovariantLiftModule
48621: 
48622: /-- An actual section of the quotient projection.  The section law is a
48623: proved field about a function into the already constructed quotient total
48624: space; no local coordinate is stored. -/
48625: structure InverseEtaQuotientSection where

48628:     ∀ x : InverseEtaBase, inverseEtaProjection (toFun x) = x

48637:     (h : ∀ x : InverseEtaBase, s x = t x) : s = t := by
48638:   cases s with
48639:   | mk sf hs =>
48640:       cases t with
48641:       | mk tf ht =>
48642:           have hfun : sf = tf := funext h
48643:           cases hfun
48644:           rfl
48645: 
48646: end InverseEtaQuotientSection

50726: /-- The genuine global distinguished quotient section is square integrable
50727: on every compact stage because its actual eta coordinate is exactly one. -/
50728: theorem distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection_isSquareIntegrable
50729:     (Y : ℝ) :
50730:     IsSquareIntegrableOnActualStage Y
50731:       distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection := by
50732:   unfold IsSquareIntegrableOnActualStage
50733:   have hCoordinate :
50734:       actualStageSectionCoordinate Y
50735:           distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection =
50736:         (fun _ : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y => (1 : ℂ)) := by
50737:     funext x
50738:     exact actualStageSectionCoordinate_distinguished Y x
50739:   rw [hCoordinate]
50740:   exact memLp_const (1 : ℂ)
50741: 
50742: /-- A genuinely square-integrable quotient section determines an element of
50743: the concrete stage Hilbert space. -/
50744: noncomputable def quotientSectionToActualStageL2
50745:     (Y : ℝ) (s : QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.InverseEtaQuotientSection)
50746:     (hs : IsSquareIntegrableOnActualStage Y s) :
50747:     ActualStageInverseEtaL2Section Y :=
50748:   MeasureTheory.MemLp.toLp (actualStageSectionCoordinate Y s) hs
50749: 
50750: /-- The `L²` representative agrees almost everywhere with the explicit eta
50751: coordinate of the original section. -/
50752: theorem quotientSectionToActualStageL2_coeFn_ae
50753:     (Y : ℝ) (s : QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.InverseEtaQuotientSection)
50754:     (hs : IsSquareIntegrableOnActualStage Y s) :
50755:     ((quotientSectionToActualStageL2 Y s hs :
50756:         ActualStageInverseEtaL2Section Y) : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y -> ℂ) =ᵐ[
50757:           actualStageMeasure Y]
50758:       actualStageSectionCoordinate Y s := by
50759:   exact hs.coeFn_toLp
50760: 
50761: /-- Reconstructing actual fibre values from the restricted `L²` coordinate
50762: recovers the original quotient section almost everywhere. -/
50763: theorem quotientSectionToActualStageL2_bundleValue_ae
50764:     (Y : ℝ) (s : QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.InverseEtaQuotientSection)
50765:     (hs : IsSquareIntegrableOnActualStage Y s) :
50766:     (fun x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y =>
50767:       actualStageBundleValue
50768:         (quotientSectionToActualStageL2 Y s hs) x) =ᵐ[
50769:           actualStageMeasure Y]
50770:       (fun x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y => s (x : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoQuotient)) := by
50771:   filter_upwards [quotientSectionToActualStageL2_coeFn_ae Y s hs]
50772:     with x hx
50773:   rw [actualStageBundleValue, hx, actualStageSectionCoordinate]
50774:   rw [← s.projection_toFun (x : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoQuotient)]
50775:   exact QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.totalOfBaseScalar_projection_coordinate
50776:     (s (x : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoQuotient))
50777: 
50778: /-! ## 5. The distinguished inverse-eta `L²` section -/
50779: 
50780: /-- The distinguished inverse-eta section on the actual stage.  Its proved eta
50781: coordinate is the constant `1`, which is in `L²` because the stage measure is
50782: finite. -/
50783: noncomputable def actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection (Y : ℝ) :
50784:     ActualStageInverseEtaL2Section Y :=
50785:   MeasureTheory.Lp.const 2 (actualStageMeasure Y) (1 : ℂ)
50786: 
50787: /-- Restriction of the genuine global distinguished quotient section agrees
50788: exactly, as an `L²` class, with the independently defined constant-one stage
50789: section. -/
50790: theorem quotientDistinguishedInverseEtaSection_toActualStageL2
50791:     (Y : ℝ) :
50792:     quotientSectionToActualStageL2 Y
50793:         distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection
50794:         (distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection_isSquareIntegrable Y) =
50795:       actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection Y := by
50796:   change quotientSectionToActualStageL2 Y
50797:       distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection
50798:       (distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection_isSquareIntegrable Y) =
50799:     MeasureTheory.Lp.const 2 (actualStageMeasure Y) (1 : ℂ)
50800:   rw [MeasureTheory.Lp.ext_iff]
50801:   filter_upwards
50802:     [quotientSectionToActualStageL2_coeFn_ae Y
50803:       distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection
50804:       (distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection_isSquareIntegrable Y),
50805:     MeasureTheory.Lp.coeFn_const
50806:       (α := QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y) (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞))
50807:       (μ := actualStageMeasure Y) (c := (1 : ℂ))]
50808:     with x hxSection hxConst
50809:   calc
50810:     quotientSectionToActualStageL2 Y
50811:           distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection
50812:           (distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection_isSquareIntegrable Y) x =
50813:         actualStageSectionCoordinate Y
50814:           distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection x := hxSection
50815:     _ = 1 := actualStageSectionCoordinate_distinguished Y x
50816:     _ = MeasureTheory.Lp.const 2
50817:           (actualStageMeasure Y) (1 : ℂ) x := by
50818:       simpa only [Function.const_apply] using hxConst.symm
50819: 
50820: /-- Fibre reconstruction from the constant-one stage `L²` class recovers
50821: the genuine global inverse-eta quotient section almost everywhere. -/
50822: theorem actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection_bundleValue_ae
50823:     (Y : ℝ) :
50824:     (fun x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y =>
50825:       actualStageBundleValue
50826:         (actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection Y) x) =ᵐ[
50827:           actualStageMeasure Y]
50828:       (fun x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y =>
50829:         distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection
50830:           (x : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoQuotient)) := by
50831:   simpa only [quotientDistinguishedInverseEtaSection_toActualStageL2] using
50832:     (quotientSectionToActualStageL2_bundleValue_ae Y
50833:       distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection
50834:       (distinguishedInverseEtaQuotientSection_isSquareIntegrable Y))
50835: 
50836: /-- The actual fibre coordinate of the distinguished section is one almost
50837: everywhere. -/
50838: theorem actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection_coordinate_ae
50839:     (Y : ℝ) :
50840:     (fun x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y =>
50841:       QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaFibreCoordinate
50842:         (actualStageFibreValue
50843:           (actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection Y) x)) =ᵐ[
50844:             actualStageMeasure Y]
50845:       (fun _ : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y => (1 : ℂ)) := by
50846:   filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.Lp.coeFn_const
50847:       (α := QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y) (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞))
50848:       (μ := actualStageMeasure Y) (c := (1 : ℂ))]
50849:     with x hx
50850:   simpa only [actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection,
50851:     actualStageFibreValue_coordinate, Function.const_apply] using hx
50852:

50884: every cutoff in the certified paper range. -/
50885: theorem actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection_ne_zero

50900:     actualStageMeasure Y Set.univ < (∞ : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
50901:       (∀ (u : ActualStageInverseEtaL2Section Y) (x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y),
50902:         QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaProjection (actualStageBundleValue u x) =
50903:           (x : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoQuotient)) ∧
50904:       (∀ u v : ActualStageInverseEtaL2Section Y,
50905:         actualStagePeterssonInner u v =
50906:           ∫ x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y, actualStagePointwiseHermitian u v x
50907:             ∂actualStageMeasure Y) ∧
50908:       (∀ u : ActualStageInverseEtaL2Section Y,
50909:         (actualStagePeterssonInner u u).re = 0 ↔ u = 0) ∧
50910:       ((fun x : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y =>
50911:         QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaFibreCoordinate
50912:           (actualStageFibreValue
50913:             (actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection Y) x)) =ᵐ[
50914:               actualStageMeasure Y]
50915:         (fun _ : QYM.FullCertification.P2IntrinsicTruncatedQuotientExtension.X Y => (1 : ℂ))) := by
50916:   exact
50917:     ⟨actualStageMeasure_univ_lt_top Y,
50918:       actualStageBundleValue_projection,
50919:       actualStagePeterssonInner_eq_integral,
50920:       actualStagePeterssonInner_self_re_eq_zero_iff,
50921:       actualStageDistinguishedInverseEtaSection_coordinate_ae Y⟩

51558: 
51559: namespace QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaSmoothTrivializationClosureExtension
51560: 
51561: 
51562: 
51563: 
51564:

51566: 
51567: 
51568: /-!
51569: # P3 closure: a transported smooth structure on the inverse-eta total space
51570: 
51571: This file closes the smooth-trivialization residual by making the atlas on the
51572: total space explicit.  The construction is deliberately a *transported*
51573: atlas.  First the global homeomorphism
51574: 
51575: `P3.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph :
51576:     P3.InverseEtaTotal ≃ₜ P3.InverseEtaBase × ℂ`
51577: 
51578: is installed as a one-chart atlas with intermediate model
51579: `P3.InverseEtaBase × ℂ`.  This is then composed, using
51580: `ChartedSpace.comp`, with the product of the P2 smooth quotient atlas and the
51581: standard complex atlas.  Therefore the preferred chart on the total space is
51582: literally the global trivialization followed by the preferred product chart.
51583: 
51584: The two smoothness proofs below are not assumptions.  In the corresponding
51585: extended charts their coordinate representatives agree locally with the
51586: identity; `writtenInExtChartAt_chartAt_comp` and its inverse version are the
51587: exact Mathlib lemmas which express those identities.
51588: 
51589: Semantic boundary: no theorem in this file claims that this transported
51590: atlas agrees with any independently proposed smooth atlas on the quotient
51591: total space.  Such a compatibility theorem would be a separate result.
51592: -/
51593: 
51594: /-! ## 1. The unconditional P2 base atlas -/
51595: 
51596: /-- The inverse-eta base is definitionally the effective `Gamma(2)` quotient
51597: constructed in P2. -/
51598: abbrev InverseEtaBase := QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.InverseEtaBase
51599: 
51600: /-- The actual inverse-eta orbit-quotient total space. -/
51601: abbrev InverseEtaTotal := QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.InverseEtaTotal
51602: 
51603: /-- The P2 all-covering-sheets atlas before composition with the standard
51604: complex atlas of the upper half-plane. -/
51605: noncomputable def inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceH :
51606:     ChartedSpace ℍ InverseEtaBase :=
51607:   QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothQuotientAtlasExtension.allCoveringSheetsChartedSpaceH
51608: 
51609: /-- The chosen complex smooth atlas on the inverse-eta base. -/
51610: noncomputable def inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex :
51611:     ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase := by
51612:   letI : ChartedSpace ℍ InverseEtaBase :=
51613:     inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceH
51614:   exact ChartedSpace.comp ℂ ℍ InverseEtaBase
51615: 
51616: /-- The chosen P2 base atlas has the ordinary smooth structure groupoid. -/
51617: theorem inverseEtaBase_hasGroupoid :
51618:     letI : ChartedSpace ℍ InverseEtaBase :=
51619:       inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceH
51620:     letI : HasGroupoid InverseEtaBase
51621:         QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothQuotientAtlasExtension.upperHalfPlaneSmoothGroupoid :=
51622:       QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothQuotientAtlasExtension.allCoveringSheets_hasGroupoid
51623:         QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothTransitionClosureExtension.smoothTransitionResidual
51624:     letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51625:       ChartedSpace.comp ℂ ℍ InverseEtaBase
51626:     HasGroupoid InverseEtaBase
51627:       (contDiffGroupoid ∞ 𝓘(ℂ)) :=
51628:   QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothTransitionClosureExtension.allCoveringSheets_hasComplexGroupoid
51629: 
51630: /-- The chosen P2 base atlas is an unconditional complex smooth manifold. -/
51631: theorem inverseEtaBase_isManifold :
51632:     letI : ChartedSpace ℍ InverseEtaBase :=
51633:       inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceH
51634:     letI : HasGroupoid InverseEtaBase
51635:         QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothQuotientAtlasExtension.upperHalfPlaneSmoothGroupoid :=
51636:       QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothQuotientAtlasExtension.allCoveringSheets_hasGroupoid
51637:         QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothTransitionClosureExtension.smoothTransitionResidual
51638:     letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51639:       ChartedSpace.comp ℂ ℍ InverseEtaBase
51640:     IsManifold 𝓘(ℂ) ∞ InverseEtaBase :=
51641:   QYM.FullCertification.P2SmoothTransitionClosureExtension.gammaTwoQuotient_isManifold
51642: 
51643: /-! ## 2. The explicitly transported atlas on the total space -/
51644: 
51645: /-- The global trivialization, regarded as the unique intermediate chart.
51646: Its source is all of the actual quotient total space. -/
51647: noncomputable def inverseEtaTotalSingletonProductChartedSpace :
51648:     ChartedSpace (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51649:   QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph
51650:     |>.singletonChartedSpace (by simp)
51651: 
51652: /-- Compose the one-chart product atlas with the chosen product complex
51653: atlas.  This is the transported smooth atlas used throughout this file. -/
51654: noncomputable def inverseEtaTotalTransportedChartedSpace :
51655:     ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal := by
51656:   letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51657:     inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51658:   letI : ChartedSpace (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51659:     inverseEtaTotalSingletonProductChartedSpace
51660:   exact ChartedSpace.comp
51661:     (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal
51662: 
51663: /-- The intermediate preferred chart is exactly the global homeomorphism. -/
51664: @[simp] theorem inverseEtaTotalSingletonProduct_chartAt
51665:     (u : InverseEtaTotal) :
51666:     @chartAt (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) _ InverseEtaTotal _
51667:         inverseEtaTotalSingletonProductChartedSpace u =
51668:       QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph :=
51669:   rfl
51670: 
51671: /-- Exact preferred-chart formula for the transported atlas. -/
51672: theorem inverseEtaTotalTransported_chartAt
51673:     (u : InverseEtaTotal) :
51674:     letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51675:       inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51676:     @chartAt (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) _ InverseEtaTotal _
51677:         inverseEtaTotalTransportedChartedSpace u =
51678:       QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.trans
51679:         (chartAt (ModelProd ℂ ℂ)
51680:           (QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph u)) := by
51681:   letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51682:     inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51683:   letI : ChartedSpace (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51684:     inverseEtaTotalSingletonProductChartedSpace
51685:   rfl
51686: 
51687: /-- The target of a transported extended chart is exactly the target of the
51688: corresponding product extended chart.  The extra intermediate chart imposes
51689: no restriction because it is a global homeomorphism. -/
51690: theorem inverseEtaTotalTransported_extChartAt_target
51691:     (u : InverseEtaTotal) :
51692:     letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51693:       inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51694:     letI : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51695:       inverseEtaTotalTransportedChartedSpace
51696:     (extChartAt (𝓘(ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ)) u).target =
51697:       (extChartAt (𝓘(ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ))
51698:         (QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph u)).target := by
51699:   letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51700:     inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51701:   letI : ChartedSpace (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51702:     inverseEtaTotalSingletonProductChartedSpace
51703:   letI : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51704:     ChartedSpace.comp
51705:       (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal
51706:   rw [extChartAt_comp]
51707:   simp only [PartialEquiv.trans_target,
51708:     Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target,
51709:     preimage_univ, inter_univ]
51710: 
51711: /-! ## 3. The forward and inverse coordinate identities -/
51712: 
51713: /-- On the target of every transported extended chart, the forward global
51714: trivialization is represented by the identity map. -/
51715: theorem inverseEta_forward_writtenInExtChartAt_eq_id
51716:     (u : InverseEtaTotal) {z : ℂ × ℂ}
51717:     (hz :
51718:       letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51719:         inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51720:       letI : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51721:         inverseEtaTotalTransportedChartedSpace
51722:       z ∈ (extChartAt (𝓘(ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ)) u).target) :
51723:     letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51724:       inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51725:     letI : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51726:       inverseEtaTotalTransportedChartedSpace
51727:     writtenInExtChartAt (𝓘(ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ))
51728:         (𝓘(ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ)) u
51729:         QYM.FullCertification.P3InverseEtaQuotientBundleExtension.inverseEtaTotalTrivializationHomeomorph z = z := by
51730:   letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51731:     inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51732:   letI : ChartedSpace (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51733:     inverseEtaTotalSingletonProductChartedSpace
51734:   letI : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51735:     ChartedSpace.comp
51736:       (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) (InverseEtaBase × ℂ) InverseEtaTotal
51737:   exact writtenInExtChartAt_chartAt_comp u hz
51738: 
51739: /-- On the same chart target, the inverse global trivialization is also
51740: represented by the identity map. -/
51741: theorem inverseEta_inverse_writtenInExtChartAt_eq_id
51742:     (u : InverseEtaTotal) {z : ℂ × ℂ}
51743:     (hz :
51744:       letI : ChartedSpace ℂ InverseEtaBase :=
51745:         inverseEtaBaseChartedSpaceComplex
51746:       letI : ChartedSpace (ModelProd ℂ ℂ) InverseEtaTotal :=
51747:         inverseEtaTotalTransportedChartedSpace
51748:       z ∈ (extChartAt (𝓘(ℂ).prod 𝓘(ℂ)) u).target) :
